whyItMatters: Pages send full URLs as referrers (<a referrerpolicy="unsafe-url">), leaking query data to linked sites.
actions: Set the policy to strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter.
Move sensitive values out of query strings regardless.
Re-run the scan and confirm no unsafe policy remains.
verification: Rescan shows no unsafe policy, and outbound requests carry trimmed referrers.
